Expandable House Introduction

NEW BRAND homes are designed for harsh environments and are built with corrosion-resistant steel sandwich panels, capable of withstanding extreme temperatures, heavy rain, and strong winds. Their reinforced frames ensure long-lasting durability, even in challenging conditions, while the insulated walls provide excellent thermal and acoustic insulation. Unlike traditional steel containers, this design is resistant to rust and degradation, ensuring a service life of 15 to 20 years with minimal maintenance costs. Whether in hot or cold climates, these structures remain sturdy and comfortable.

●  Expandable Container House

●  Premium Steel Sandwich Panels

●  Lifespan 15-20 years with proper maintenance

key Advantages

Fast Assembly
Prefab container homes can be installed fast, reducing construction time and costs compared to traditional construction.
Cost-Effective
Competitively priced offers an affordable alternative to traditional housing without sacrificing quality.
Eco-Friendly Design
Sustainable materials and modular construction reduce waste and environmental impact.
Low Maintenance
Corrosion-resistant steel and weatherproof panels ensure long-term durability with minimal maintenance costs (15-20 year lifespan).

More about Expandable Home

One of the outstanding features of this container house is its expandable modular design, which can be easily customized according to space requirements. The units can be quickly assembled and expanded to create additional space. With different door and window configurations, electrical accessories, and internal layout options, it can be suitable for family houses or seaside villas.

◎ Standard Size: 20ft / 40ft (custom sizes available)

◎ Doors/Windows: PVC or aluminum alloy options

◎ Fire Resistance: Meets industry safety standards

Why Choose NEW BRAND?

[Location] NEW BRAND Container House combines practicality, sustainability, and a wide range of customization options to meet the global market's demand for efficient, high-quality prefab structures. Whether for personal, commercial, or institutional use, the product provides a reliable and customizable solution in the growing field of modular construction.


◎ Innovative Engineering: Combining cutting-edge materials with practical design.

◎ Customer Focus: Providing tailor-made solutions and reliable support from consultation to installation.

◎ Trusted Quality: Backed by years of manufacturing expertise and international standards.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

1
What Is The NEW BRAND Expandable Container Home Made Of?
The home is built with high-quality steel sandwich panels, which provide excellent insulation, durability, and weather resistance.
2
Can I Customize The Container Home?
Yes! You can customize the size, color, layout, and interior accessories to meet your specific requirements.
3
Is Suitable For Extreme Weather Conditions?
Yes, the container home is windproof, waterproof, and insulated, making it ideal for different climates, including hot, cold, and rainy environments.
4
How Long Will This Container Home Last?
If properly maintained, the home can last for more than 10 years, making it a long-term, cost-effective investment.
5
Is The Container Home Fireproof?
Yes, it has a fire rating of A, ensuring safety in the event of a fire.
6
What Support Do You Provide After Purchase?
NEW BRAND provides online after-sales support, CAD design assistance, and installation guidance to help customers with installation.
